lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Publication, presentation, or reflection: multi-step multiplication problems

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Notice how the explanation names the reason for each step.

steps: The parentheses group 18 + 7 as one sum.
The multiplication sign places 6 groups of that sum.
Describe those operations without finding either the sum or the product.
workedSolution.answer: Multiply 6 by the sum of 18 and 7.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: For 2 event days, a booth sells 50 tickets each day at $3 per ticket. What projected revenue will the booth earn?
Maya has 7 times as many cards as Leo. Leo has 26 cards. How many cards does Maya have?
An area model for 4205 × 98 splits 4205 into 4000 + 200 + 5 and 98 into 90 + 8. What total product does the model represent?
Use partial products to calculate 4765 × 76. Decompose both factors by place value, multiply each pair of parts, and add the partial products. What is the product?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Explain your method so that someone who has not done this unit could follow it.

items.prompt: Use the standard multiplication algorithm to calculate 9702 × 65.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Estimate 6450 × 819 by rounding 6450 to the nearest thousand and 819 to the nearest hundred.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
